clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked into the eastern cliffs of Mulgore, the Venture Co. Mine is an unauthorized industrial excavation run by greedy goblin opportunists. Despite being denied rights by the tauren, the Venture Company dug into the hills regardless, threatening the natural balance of the plains.

When the Venture Company sought rights to strip Mulgore of its minerals, the tauren flatly refused. The corporate cartel ignored them, tunneling deep into the eastern mountain wall anyway under the direction of Supervisor Fizsprocket. Their sprawling complex features three entrances—a ground tunnel guarded by hired muscle, a sheer cliffside overlook, and an upper passage leading out to a small lumber camp. The encroaching machines, smoke, and slag heaps represent a blatant defilement of sacred land.
